note.after_visit_summary:
Your worry and sleep have gotten about halfway better since starting your medicine, but some worry and trouble falling asleep are still there. Your test for anxiety score was 12, which is better than before but still in the moderate range. Your blood pressure and heart rate are normal. You looked a little tense, and you agree.

We are changing your escitalopram to 20 mg once a day. For now, take two of your 10 mg pills each morning until the new refill arrives. Keep taking hydroxyzine 25 mg for hard moments, no more than once a day, and do not drive after taking it. Keep taking magnesium glycinate 200 mg at night. Drink no more than 2 cups of coffee a day, and none after noon. Keep your CBT sessions every other week.

Call or text 988 right away if you ever have thoughts of hurting yourself.

Please come back in about 6 weeks, around November 4th, before your baby is born. If you feel worse before then, call us.
